content.short: A tool to help the NFT Community understand their investments and make an educated decision.
content.description:
Have you ever been in a situation where you wanted to do a research on an NFT project and you had no time to actually finish it? Or maybe even didn't want to actually do the research and you have been stolen of your ADA?

Well, here enters Raqoon.io, a website that dives deep into an NFT project and does the research for you, helps you understand it clearly and provides the Author's review on each one. Welcome to Raqoon.io!
